name: Excessive accent-colored outlines
summary: Use neutral 1px focus rings and quiet fills for focus and selection; keep the accent for the primary action and meaning.
problem: Emerald rings on every input, emerald selected rows and emerald checkboxes make the whole product shout. When everything is accent coloured, the primary action and real status lose their signal.

bad.description: A 2px accent ring on a focused input, an accent frame on the selected row and an accent checkbox.

good.title: Neutral focus and quiet selection
good.description: A 1px --focus ring on inputs, a --select fill on the selected row and a neutral checkbox. The ring still reaches 3:1 against the surface.

why: Neutral treatments keep keyboard focus visible without stealing attention, and they leave emerald free for identity, primary actions and meaning.
exceptions: Semantic colour is allowed where it conveys information, such as a destructive field error or a trading gain.
If a neutral ring cannot reach 3:1 against an unusual surface (for example a bright image), a stronger ring is allowed there.

humanReview: Is the focus ring still clearly visible with the keyboard?
Is the selected state a quiet fill rather than a frame?
